# ICRM — International Christian Rehab Mission
# https://www.icrm.org.uk/llms.txt

> ICRM (International Christian Rehab Mission) is a UK-based Christian
> organisation that delivers the Gospel through therapy and rehabilitation
> programmes, combining faith-based support with practical care for
> individuals and communities in need.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.icrm.org.uk/): Overview of ICRM's mission, vision, and work
- [About](https://www.icrm.org.uk/about): Who we are, our history, values, and team
- [Our Work](https://www.icrm.org.uk/our-work): Therapy programmes and rehabilitation initiatives
- [Get Involved](https://www.icrm.org.uk/get-involved): How to volunteer, pray, or partner with ICRM
- [Stories](https://www.icrm.org.uk/stories): Testimonies and transformation stories
- [News](https://www.icrm.org.uk/news): Latest updates, events, and announcements
- [Contact](https://www.icrm.org.uk/contact): Get in touch with the ICRM team

## Key Facts

- Organisation: International Christian Rehab Mission (ICRM)
- Founded: August 2023
- Location: 3 Wood Rise, Pinner, Greater London, HA5 2JD, United Kingdom
- Website: https://www.icrm.org.uk
- Focus: Gospel-centred therapy and rehabilitation
- Services: Occupational Therapy, Physical Therapy, Counselling
- Areas Served: India, United Kingdom
- Contact: admin@icrm.org.uk
